head.t: da Vinci 5 gains CE mark for adult cardiac surgery in Europe
head.x: Intuitive says da Vinci 5 received CE mark for adult cardiac surgery in Europe, including coronary artery bypass.

head.t: Da Vinci 5 surgical system CE marked for adult cardiac surgery
head.x: Intuitive has announced that its da Vinci 5 surgical system has received CE mark approval for adult cardiac surgery in Europe, including thoracoscopically-assisted cardiotomy procedures and minimally invasive coronary artery bypass procedures.
